title: Conditor acceptance-trust preflight contract (conditor.acceptance.json)
description: Pins the inputs the acceptance verifier will trust at the end of a timed run and names that verifier. `conditor acceptance preflight` runs the verifier's own --preflight mode; Conditor adds no acceptance rule (CON-ACC-PREFLIGHT).

verifier.description: Command of the authoritative acceptance verifier, run from the target directory. It must implement --preflight and answer causa.acceptance-preflight/1.

baselineSource.description: Git checkout holding the baseline's source commit (default '.').

sha256.description: Pinned here; never computed from the file at preflight time.
